mapper.sql: from cm_collection_current current_revision join cm_collection c on c.id=current_revision.collection_id and c.status='0' join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=current_revision.collection_revision_id and r.collection_id=c.id and r.status='published' and r.collection_type='SIMULATION' join cm_exam_certification certification on certification.id=r.certification_id and certification.status='0' join cm_syllabus_version syllabus on syllabus.id=r.syllabus_version_id and syllabus.certification_id=certification.id

c.id collection_id,r.id revision_id,c.collection_code,r.collection_name, r.certification_id,certification.certification_name,r.syllabus_version_id, syllabus.version_name syllabus_version_name,r.question_count,r.total_report_score, r.duration_minutes,r.published_time, count(distinct q.exam_subject_id)::int subject_count,min(q.exam_subject_id) subject_id, min(subject.subject_name) subject_name, coalesce(bool_or(question_revision.question_type='CHOICE'),false) has_choice, coalesce(bool_or(question_revision.question_type='CASE'),false) has_case, coalesce(bool_or(question_revision.question_type='ESSAY'),false) has_essay, count(item.id)::int actual_question_count,coalesce(sum(item.report_score),0) actual_total_report_score, (select s.id from cm_learning_session s where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.collection_revision_id=r.id and s.session_type='simulation' and s.status in('created','in_progress','submitted','settling') and exists(select 1 from cm_user_goal g where g.id=s.goal_id and g.user_id=#{userId} and g.status='active') order by s.create_time desc,s.id desc limit 1) active_session_id, (select s.status from cm_learning_session s where s.user_id=#{userId} and s.collection_revision_id=r.id and s.session_type='simulation' and s.status in('created','in_progress','submitted','settling') and exists(select 1 from cm_user_goal g where g.id=s.goal_id and g.user_id=#{userId} and g.status='active') order by s.create_time desc,s.id desc limit 1) active_session_status

left join cm_collection_item item on item.collection_revision_id=r.id left join cm_question_revision question_revision on question_revision.id=item.question_revision_id left join cm_question q on q.id=question_revision.question_id and q.del_flag='0' left join cm_exam_subject subject on subject.id=q.exam_subject_id and subject.certification_id=r.certification_id
mapper.select: select goal.id,goal.certification_id,certification.certification_name,goal.syllabus_version_id, syllabus.version_name syllabus_version_name,goal.row_version from cm_user_goal goal join cm_exam_certification certification on certification.id=goal.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version syllabus on syllabus.id=goal.syllabus_version_id where goal.user_id=#{userId} and goal.status='active' order by goal.update_time desc,goal.id desc limit 1

select goal.id,goal.certification_id,certification.certification_name,goal.syllabus_version_id,syllabus.version_name syllabus_version_name,goal.row_version from cm_user_goal goal join cm_exam_certification certification on certification.id=goal.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version syllabus on syllabus.id=goal.syllabus_version_id where goal.user_id=#{userId} and goal.status='active' order by goal.update_time desc,goal.id desc limit 1 for update
select id from cm_profile_rule_version where status='published' order by published_time desc,id desc limit 1

select q.id question_id,qr.id question_revision_id,q.exam_subject_id,item.item_order question_order,qr.question_type,qr.stem,qr.answer::text answer_json,qr.analysis,coalesce(qr.difficulty,'medium') difficulty,qr.estimated_seconds,coalesce(nullif(btrim(q.evidence_group_key),''),concat('Q:',q.id)) evidence_group_key,item.report_score::text report_score,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('label',o.option_label,'content',o.option_text,'sortOrder',o.sort_order) order by o.sort_order,o.id) from cm_question_option o where o.question_revision_id=qr.id),'[]')::text options_json,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceUrl',im.source_url,'storagePath',im.storage_path,'altText',im.alt_text,'sortOrder',im.image_order) order by im.image_order,im.id) from cm_question_image im where im.question_revision_id=qr.id),'[]')::text images_json,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('knowledgePointId',kp.id::text,'examSubjectId',kp.exam_subject_id::text,'relationRole','tested') order by kp.id) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and kp.del_flag='0' and kp.status='0' and not exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id=kp.id and child.del_flag='0' and child.status='0')),'[]')::text knowledge_json from cm_collection_current current_revision join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=current_revision.collection_revision_id and r.status='published' and r.collection_type='SIMULATION' join cm_collection_item item on item.collection_revision_id=r.id join cm_question_revision qr on qr.id=item.question_revision_id and qr.status='published' join cm_question q on q.id=qr.question_id and q.del_flag='0' where current_revision.collection_id=#{collectionId} order by item.item_order,item.id
select coalesce(max(formal_attempt_no),0)+1 from cm_learning_session where user_id=#{userId} and goal_id=#{goalId} and collection_revision_id=#{revisionId} and session_type='simulation'

select s.id session_id,s.user_id,s.status,s.row_version,s.deadline_time,count(sq.id)::int total_count,count(a.id) filter(where a.status='submitted')::int answered_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='simulation' group by s.id

select s.id session_id,s.user_id,s.status,s.row_version,s.deadline_time,count(sq.id)::int total_count,count(a.id) filter(where a.status='submitted')::int answered_count from cm_learning_session s left join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='simulation' group by s.id for update

select s.id session_id,s.goal_id,s.rule_version_id,sq.id session_question_id,sq.question_id,sq.question_revision_id,sq.evidence_group_key,sq.exam_subject_id,sq.difficulty_snapshot difficulty,sq.question_order,sq.presentation_snapshot::text presentation_snapshot,sq.grading_snapshot::text grading_snapshot,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text knowledge_snapshot,a.id attempt_id,aa.answer_data::text,aa.grading_status,aa.score::text score,aa.max_score::text max_score from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='simulation' order by sq.question_order

select sq.id session_question_id,sq.question_revision_id,sq.question_order,sq.presentation_snapshot::text presentation_snapshot,sq.grading_snapshot::text grading_snapshot,sq.knowledge_snapshot::text knowledge_snapshot,a.id attempt_id,aa.answer_data::text,aa.grading_status from cm_learning_session s join cm_session_question sq on sq.session_id=s.id left join cm_question_attempt a on a.session_question_id=sq.id and a.status='submitted' left join cm_attempt_answer aa on aa.attempt_id=a.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='simulation' and sq.question_order=#{questionOrder}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_attempt_answer(id,attempt_id,answer_data,score,max_score,score_rate,grading_status,graded_time) values(#{id},#{attemptId},#{answerData}::jsonb,#{scoreRate}::numeric,1,#{scoreRate}::numeric,#{status},case when #{status}='graded' then now() else null end)
mapper.update: update cm_attempt_answer set score=#{scoreRate}::numeric,max_score=1,score_rate=#{scoreRate}::numeric,grading_status='graded',grading_result=#{result}::jsonb,graded_time=now() where attempt_id=#{attemptId} and grading_status='pending'
update cm_attempt_answer set score=0,max_score=1,score_rate=0,grading_status='failed',grading_result=#{result}::jsonb,graded_time=now() where attempt_id=#{attemptId} and grading_status='pending'

update cm_learning_session set status='submitted',submitted_time=now(),status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type='simulation' and status='in_progress'

update cm_learning_session set status='completed',settled_time=now(),status_changed_time=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{sessionId} and user_id=#{userId} and session_type='simulation' and status='submitted'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_assessment_report(id,session_id,user_id,report_type,total_score,max_score,subject_scores,profile_summary) values(#{id},#{sessionId},#{userId},'simulation',#{score}::numeric,#{maxScore}::numeric,'{}'::jsonb,jsonb_build_object('scoreComplete',not #{partial})) on conflict(session_id) do update set total_score=excluded.total_score,max_score=excluded.max_score,profile_summary=excluded.profile_summary
mapper.select: select s.id session_id,s.status,r.total_score::text score,r.max_score::text max_score from cm_learning_session s left join cm_assessment_report r on r.session_id=s.id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.user_id=#{userId} and s.session_type='simulation'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_error_record(id,user_id,goal_id,attempt_id,knowledge_point_id,evidence_group_key) values(#{id},#{userId},#{goalId},#{attemptId},#{knowledgePointId},#{groupKey}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select:
select distinct certification.id certification_id,certification.certification_name, certification.sort_order certification_sort_order,syllabus.id syllabus_version_id, syllabus.version_name syllabus_version_name,syllabus.published_date syllabus_published_date
order by certification.sort_order,certification.id,syllabus.published_date desc nulls last,syllabus.id desc

select item.item_order question_order,question_revision.question_type,question_revision.stem
join cm_collection_item item on item.collection_revision_id=r.id join cm_question_revision question_revision on question_revision.id=item.question_revision_id and question_revision.status='published' join cm_question q on q.id=question_revision.question_id and q.del_flag='0' where c.id=#{collectionId} order by item.item_order asc,item.id asc
